capabilities: Display a monthly calendar in the sidebar
Create daily, weekly and monthly periodic notes
Configure up to four recurring schedules with periods and hours
Assign custom colored statuses to dates
Track work periods with timers and Markdown reports
extras: Fork of Calendar 1.5.10 by Liam Cain; attribution in FORK.md. No telemetry; data stays local. Fresh install contains no schedules, statuses or user data.
intentEvidence: based on Calendar 1.5.10 by Liam Cain
problem: Users need a calendar view to manage periodic notes, rotating schedules and day statuses in one place.

relations.evidence: based on Calendar 1.5.10 by Liam Cain

summary: Calendar plugin for periodic notes, recurring schedules, day statuses and optional work-period timers.
